patch_description: Insights show cost increases monotonically with spreading (more aggressive spreading costs more: half-spread 1002.43 < round-robin 1015.93 < cycling 1034.51 < pure Dijkstra 1035.14). So assign ALL partitions for each dst to the single cheapest candidate path, keeping the k=4 candidate generation and Dijkstra fallback purely for robustness. This reduces redundant transfers while retaining structural advantages.
